messages:
olga: heads up — deploy-bot paused the promotion for commit b7f9a. failing axis: linux-arm64-e2e. saw this in the final canary before prod.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion paused for commit b7f9a due to failing job linux-arm64-e2e. CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/2034 :rotating_light:

rahul: opening the job logs now. initial error is docker pull failing with `manifest unknown` on one of the layers.

tess: hmm that sounds like an image layer got GC'd or CDN cache purge hit the arm mirror. did anyone run a prune earlier?

rahul: log excerpt:
```
time="2026-03-21T16:02:04Z" level=error msg="pulling image registry.internal/org/app:abc123-arm failed: manifest unknown"
http: response status 404 Not Found
```

olga: we did schedule a storage scrub earlier today (storage-team note at 15:30 PT), they said it was safe but maybe the mirror glue job didn't finish.

release-mgr: what's the time to unblock if infra has to rehydrate the blob? our change window closes at 17:00 PT.

rahul: infra oncall said rehydrate could be 20-40m if they can fetch the original push artifacts; if not, they'd need a repush from CI which requires a rebuild.

tess: can we just rerun the arm axis? `deploy-bot rerun --commit=b7f9a --axis=linux-arm64-e2e`

olga: tried rerun — it fails early during image pull with same 404, so rerun won't help until infra fixes the registry.

deploy-bot: [automated] Re-run attempted for linux-arm64-e2e (b7f9a). Failed on pre-test pull step.

release-mgr: given the window and other axes green (linux-x86-e2e, windows-e2e, integration), I propose pin to last-green commit c3d2e and push release. We can schedule an expedited backport/hotfix once the artifact is back.

rahul: +1 — we'd also want an incident with timeline and the blob IDs. I'll create INC-20260321-02 and attach CI logs and storage scrub job details.

tess: +1. I'll draft release notes indicating we pinned due to an artifact availability issue and will follow up with a patch. Suggested blurb: `Pinned to last-known-good commit due to missing arm image layer; rebuild/repush in progress.`

olga: I'll escalate to storage infra to check whether the scrub deleted the mirror copy or only tombstoned it. tagging them in #eng-infra now.

deploy-bot: [automated] Manual promote requested: `deploy-bot promote --tag=release-2026-03-21 --commit=c3d2e --reason="pin after arm image fetch failure"` by release-mgr. Approval required to proceed.

release-mgr: approved. proceeding with manual promote.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion job 3077 queued for tag release-2026-03-21 -> commit c3d2e.

rahul: incident INC-20260321-02 created and linked in the CI run. storage team acknowledged; they started a rehydrate job and estimate 25m.

tess: good. once storage confirms the arm image is back, we should run a full canary for b7f9a and decide on a hotfix fastpath.

olga: action list:
- @rahul: file incident with logs and blob ids (done)
- @tess: update release notes draft and docs location (drive: docs/releases/2026-03-21-release-notes.md)
- @olga: follow up in #eng-infra on rehydrate progress and notify here when b7f9a artifacts are healthy
- @release-mgr: sign-off on manual promote (done)

release-mgr: posting final sign-off. release will go out pinned to c3d2e. if the rehydrate completes and b7f9a can be fully validated we'll consider a quick follow-up rollout. thanks everyone. :shipit:
